name: webs
description: Connect agents to Webs memory over remote MCP: save, recall, ask, watch, run, readiness, and on-demand context.

interface.shortDescription: Connect agents to Webs memory over remote MCP: save, recall, ask, watch, run, readiness, and on-demand context.
interface.longDescription: Webs is where the web becomes memory. The remote MCP server gives agents the same memory surface humans use: save source URLs with task and why, recall saved memory with citations, ask questions over memory, create monitors, run durable research, check readiness, and request small task-affinity context packets. The context verb is strictly on demand; this plugin teaches judgment rather than automatic prompt injection.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my Webs memory connection is ready.
Recall what we have saved about this task.
Ask Webs memory a cited question.
